title: [GMCP 203.038.06] Operations and evidence: Catalog, discovery, health, compatibility, and trust intelligence
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-038-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Local configs, running processes, package managers, the official registry and explicit endpoints reconcile into one deduplicated catalog with provenance. Active probes measure protocol/extension compatibility, health, latency and policy fitness without granting trust; recommendations explain evidence and cost; stale or conflicting records converge; and discovery never installs, enables or sends data without authorization. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
